title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2609.38006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer

translated_title: HARISSA：面向高效且安全的本地语言模型部署的推理时自检方法
translated_abstract: 在本地运行语言模型具有隐私、延迟和成本方面的优势，但本地硬件只能容纳较小的模型，其能力不及前沿模型。对于困难查询，通常的解决方案是将其升级到云端模型，但这会牺牲本地运行在隐私和成本上的优势。完全本地化的部署在处理困难查询时面临两个决策。第一，它可以在某个查询上投入更多计算，例如在回答前进行推理，这会提高准确性但增加延迟，因此必须判断哪些查询值得付出额外计算（效率问题）。第二，某些查询超出了本地模型的能力范围，给出错误答案比将查询转交给人工处理更糟糕，因此必须判断哪些答案可以安全地交付（安全问题）。我们证明这两个决策都可以基于模型自身的隐藏状态来做出。在任何token生成之前计算出的预填充状态，能够预测模型是否会回答
tldr: 该论文提出HARISSA方法，通过利用语言模型自身的隐藏状态在推理时进行自检，同时解决本地部署中的效率问题（判断哪些查询值得额外计算）和安全问题（判断哪些答案可以安全交付），实现无需云端升级的高效安全本地语言模型部署。
en_tdlr: HARISSA uses the language model's own hidden states as inference-time self-checks to jointly address efficiency (deciding which queries merit extra computation) and safety (deciding which answers are safe to deliver), enabling efficient and safe fully-local LLM deployment without cloud escalation.
